detail.longDescription: RE: https:// floss.social/@rdnielsen/117532 392549451667 this is what happens when we decontextualize (and depoliticize) and human interaction we end up with this, passing for science, which treats each human interaction as if it happens in a vacuum. this type of “science” requires that researchers pretend to be stupid, disregard every aspect of humanness, to call their findings “unbiased” this is not science, people. this is merely the best means for scientists to make a living under neoliberal era capitalism. they tell themselves this data is crucial for policy makers and legislators but it’s not, and there is plenty of evidence that shows definitively that neither policy makers nor legislators give a rip about research, data, empirical evidence etc. people are simply making their living doing the work that is funded. that context matters, too. we are not gaining any insight here, but rather allowing ourselves to indulge in assumptions based on halfassed observations that are divorced from the social and material conditions under which they manifest. # neoliberalfascism # Research # empiricalevidence # decontextualized # depoliticization # capitalism # scienceisnotneutral
